summary: Feedback-value experiment: chronological split of the 45 labelled papers (22 feedback / 23 evaluation) and Rocchio-style profile variants (frozen seed, +positives, +positives-negatives) with time-safe IDF and full-label metrics. AUC: recency 0.52 < frozen 0.94 < +pos 0.96 < +pos-neg 0.99, monotone across negative weights. Directional support that explicit feedback improves ranking, but n=23 and proxy-label circularity mean E-FEEDBACK-VALUE stays not_run.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit d006de3. Tooling/tests/registries/docs; cached labels, no network or model calls.

budget_impact.rationale: No runtime or model call; local TF-IDF over cached candidates and labels. Runtime operations/ceilings unchanged.
budget_impact.before: Only a static seed profile was evaluated; no feedback-vs-frozen comparison existed.
budget_impact.after: Feedback command compares frozen/updated profiles with AUC and mean-rank; directional gain recorded, gate not passed.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Primary split; AUC/mean-rank per profile variant

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; evaluation tooling only, not product quality

open_risks: n=23 evaluation items; AUC deltas are within noise at this size.
Single chronological split, not the required >=10-batch rolling sequence.
Same annotator produced feedback and evaluation labels; circularity risk.
